style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;size=12;align=left;spacingLeft=6;fontSize=11;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" value="<b>pattern</b> is one of: weekly (chosen days of the week), monthly (a day of the month), daily.<br><b>Assumptions</b>&nbsp;:<br>A1. Availability is cut into bookable slots of slotMinutes (default 30, as in the sample CSV).<br>A2. All-or-nothing: if any new slot overlaps an existing slot of the same professional, no slot is created.<br>A3. Every slot applies at one ClinicLocation; slots imported from CSV use the default "Main Clinic".<br>A4. Minutes left over that do not fill a whole slot are not used (09:00–10:45 at 30 min gives 3 slots).<br>A5. Slots that only touch (09:00–09:30 and 09:30–10:00) do not overlap.<br>A6. Each professional exists once in the system, matched by name (the CSV has no licence number); overlaps are checked per professional." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="144" width="740" x="80" y="510" value="<b>GRASP.</b> Controller: ConsultationController is the use-case controller that receives UC2 system operations and keeps the consultation context between them. Information Expert: Appointment answers canStart (status BOOKED or ARRIVED, slot date = today) and isAssignedTo, using its TimeSlot; Patient gives its ClinicalRecord (composition). Creator: ActivityLog records and creates ActivityRecords (timestamp, action, performedBy, linked to p). Pure Fabrication: AppointmentRegistry (lookup) and ActivityLog (audit).<br><b>Design decisions.</b> UserAccount is a design class for the identified user (role + linked HealthcareProfessional); the domain model has no user concept. canStart accepts ARRIVED as well as BOOKED, resolving the CO4 note that Register Arrival would otherwise block UC2." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="2030" div.div:
GRASP. Controller: ConsultationController is the use-case controller that receives UC2 system operations and keeps the consultation context between them. Information Expert: Appointment answers canStart (status BOOKED or ARRIVED, slot date = today) and isAssignedTo, using its TimeSlot; Patient gives its ClinicalRecord (composition). Creator: ActivityLog records and creates ActivityRecords (timestamp, action, performedBy, linked to p). Pure Fabrication: AppointmentRegistry (lookup) and ActivityLog (audit).
Design decisions. UserAccount is a design class for the identified user (role + linked HealthcareProfessional); the domain model has no user concept. canStart accepts ARRIVED as well as BOOKED, resolving the CO4 note that Register Arrival would otherwise block UC2.
